'''2018 European MPC Results Joe Olson DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joe Olson]] at [[2018 European Match Play Championship]] (Results).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Joe Olson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 European Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-match-play-championships/ PC list]
